chapter: Black and Tan and Kansas City nightlife
title: First meeting Duke Ellington in Kansas City
summary: Ellington said he'd bring Turner to New York; Turner first worked for him in 'Jump for Joy'.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: So, is that where you first met Ellington? When he came to...
When I first met Duke Ellington, when he used to come to Kansas City. He used to always tell me that he gonna bring me to New York wit' him.
And he never did that. The first time you worked with him was in "Jump For Joy." Is that right?
Yeah. The first time I ever worked for him was "Jump For Joy" but, ahhh, that was a long time after that.
Yeah, but, so when you first met him was what-- in...how...what...do you remember what year it was or how old you were when you first met him?
Oh, I guess I's in my thirties when I met him. He used to come to Kansas City and bring his whole band. He was a young man then himself.
And that's when he first heard you sing...
Was there at...was...would that have been the Black and Tan or...what...what club would you have been working at?
Sunset Club. I worked the Sunset...the Sunset nightclub, Twelfth and Highland or Woodland or somewhere around in there.
